note: Perkins County SD publishes parcel data only through vendor viewers (Schneider Beacon/qPublic, CAMAVision, southdakotadirectors). Beacon returns a Cloudflare 403 challenge; no public ArcGIS REST parcel service was found. County GIS page says basic GIS access requires a subscription form. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Perkins County parcels returned nothing; statewide SD searches found no county parcel layer. Commercial sources (Regrid, landrecords.us, Equator) are not county services.
